simple.meaning: שַׁעַלְבֹנִי (Shaʻalbônîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Shaalbonite or inhabitant of Shaalbin.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שַׁעַלְבֹנִי (H8170) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 23:32, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׁעַלְבֹנִי (H8170) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שַׁעַלְבֹנִי (H8170) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שַׁעַלְבֹנִי (Shaʻalbônîy) / H8170 is traced through 2 Samuel 23:32, 1 Chronicles 11:33 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
